visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged male speaker with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a black long-sleeved button-up shirt, stands centrally against a dark grey background. To his right, an orange traffic cone is partially visible. He holds a small black remote in his right hand and gestures expressively with both hands. A purple banner with white text sits at the top, while white and yellow captions appear in the center and bottom. (2) The visual layout shifts to a split screen where the speaker is placed at the bottom, while the top half displays scientific figures. Figure A shows a brown fossilized rib bone with a purple 'Cut Section' indicator. Figure C is a microscopic scan of bone texture with a red bounding box labeled 'Regions with large, mineralized vessel-like structures.' The lighting is consistent and bright studio style. (3) The screen displays a 3D digital reconstruction of a vascular network. The branching tube-like structures are colored in a spectrum from green to blue on a black background. White arrows and labels '538 µm', '165 µm', and '5 mm' indicate specific measurements. The speaker remains in the bottom frame, pointing upwards towards the model. (4) A grid of scientific heatmaps labeled C through F appears. Each image uses false colors (red, green, blue) to show the density of elements like Iron (Fe), Calcium (Ca), and Manganese (Mn). The speaker continues his presentation from the bottom, maintaining eye contact with the camera. (5) The final segment returns to the initial framing of the speaker against the grey background and traffic cone. He summarizes the findings while rotating the small remote between his fingers. The text overlays continue to update at the bottom reflecting his speech.

(4) [Subtitle]: 發現了牠驚人的自癒秘密. (5) [Subtitle]: 結果剛剛發表在《科學報告》上. (6) [Subtitle]: 這隻6700萬年前的暴龍老兄. (7) [Subtitle]: 編號RSKM P2523.8. (8) [Subtitle]: 生前肯定是個陣頭的角頭. (9) [Subtitle]: 身上傷痕累累. (16) [Subtitle]: 跟里賈納大學的科學家就好奇啦. (17) [Subtitle]: 這骨頭要癒合. (18) [Subtitle]: 不能跟金屬球棒一樣靠氣勢. (19) [Subtitle]: 需要超大量的血液來運送養分. (20) [Subtitle]: 那Scotty的身體是怎麼辦到的. (21) [Subtitle]: 為了看穿這6700萬年的骨頭. (22) [Subtitle]: 他們把化石帶到加拿大光源同步加速器. (23) [Subtitle]: 用最頂尖的同步輻射微電腦斷層掃描 (SR-μCT). (24) [Subtitle]: 這讓他們可以在原位. (25) [Subtitle]: 也就是不破壞化石的情況下. (26) [Subtitle]: 開啟清澈透明的世界. (27) [Subtitle]: 看到骨頭內部最精細的3D結構. (28) [Subtitle]: 結果不得了. (29) [Subtitle]: 他們在斷骨的周圍. (30) [Subtitle]: 發現了一個超複雜像樹根一樣盤根錯節的管狀網絡. (31) [Subtitle]: 直徑從100到500微米不等. (32) [Subtitle]: 比骨骼裡負責正常供血細小的哈佛氏管. (33) [Subtitle]: 粗了好幾十倍. (34) [Subtitle]: 而且在距離斷點5公分遠的正常骨頭裡面. (35) [Subtitle]: 完全找不到這種結構. (36) [Subtitle]: 就是這個. (37) [Subtitle]: 這就是所謂的「血管增生」. (38) [Subtitle]: 簡單說就是為了加速療傷. (39) [Subtitle]: Scotty的身體在這裡緊急加開了. (40) [Subtitle]: 好幾條血管高速公路. (41) [Subtitle]: 瘋狂地往斷點運送血液跟養分. (42) [Subtitle]: 哎你不用問. (43) [Subtitle]: 因為每一個看過侏羅紀公園的人. (44) [Subtitle]: 包括科學家都想問. (45) [Subtitle]: 那裡面還有血嗎. (46) [Subtitle]: 所以他們接著用X光進行化學分析. (47) [Subtitle]: 發現裡面早就沒有有機物了. (48) [Subtitle]: 而是被黃鐵礦. (49) [Subtitle]: 以及部分氧化後的針鐵礦給填滿. (50) [Subtitle]: 形成了一個完美的礦化鑄模. (51) [Subtitle]: 也就是說. visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An adult male with short, neat dark hair and rectangular glasses. He is wearing a simple black button-up shirt and is holding a small remote device.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The initial and closing background is a neutral grey studio wall with a traffic cone as a quirky prop. The middle section utilizes digital overlays of scientific diagrams, 3D bone models, and X-ray chemical analysis charts.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narration begins with a professional and articulate tone. A quick 'whoosh' sound effect highlights the visual title transition. The background music is a steady, upbeat electronic track with a prominent synth bassline and rhythmic drum machine patterns at 128 BPM. (2) As the narrator discusses scientific data, his pitch remains moderate with dynamic variability to emphasize key terms like 'Scotty' and 'CT scan.' Frequent 'pop' or 'bubble' sound effects are synchronized with the appearance of text and diagram overlays. Ambient noise is virtually non-existent, indicating a high-quality studio recording. (3) During the description of the 3D vascular model, the narrator's volume increases slightly, conveying excitement. The BGM remains consistent in the mix, providing a driving energy without masking the speech. A subtle 'ding' sound occurs as a measurement label appears on the screen. (4) The conclusion features a slightly more relaxed vocal delivery with a touch of humor. The BGM undergoes a subtle volume swell before reaching a definitive hard cut that aligns with the end of the video, leaving no trailing reverb or music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Explanation of Discovery -> Technical Methodology -> Significance/Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience about a recent scientific breakthrough regarding dinosaur fossils. Specifically, it explains how researchers used advanced CT scans to discover evidence of 'vascular proliferation' in a Tyrannosaurus rex fossil, suggesting advanced self-healing capabilities in ancient apex predators.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker explicitly asks viewers to join the 'PanSci' (泛糰) membership at the start of the video.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A well-produced educational short that balances technical scientific data with high-energy social-media-style presentation. The use of BGM and SFX effectively maintains viewer engagement.
